title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid credentials and receives a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the Sign Up page
Fill in valid user details (e.g., email, username, password)
Submit the registration form
Verify registration success message is shown
Verify a JWT token is issued and stored

title: User Registration Fail on Invalid Input
description: Ensure registration fails with appropriate validation errors when required fields are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to the Sign Up page
Submit empty or malformed registration form
Verify validation error messages are displayed for each invalid field
Ensure no user is created and no JWT token is issued

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that existing users can login successfully using valid credentials and obtain a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the Login page
Input valid username/email and password
Click the login button
Verify login success and JWT token is received
Verify user is redirected to main authenticated page or dashboard

title: User Login Fail on Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails gracefully with incorrect username or password and no token is issued.

steps.description: Navigate to the Login page
Enter invalid username/email or password
Click the login button
Verify error message about incorrect credentials
Verify no JWT token is issued

title: Access Protected Route with Valid JWT
description: Verify that routes protected by JWT middleware are accessible with a valid token.

steps.description: Authenticate user and obtain valid JWT token
Attempt to access a protected API route or React component
Verify access is granted and data is returned or UI is displayed

title: Access Protected Route with Invalid or Missing JWT
description: Verify that routes protected by JWT middleware reject requests with invalid or no token.

steps.description: Attempt to access a protected API route or React component without JWT
Verify access is denied and appropriate error (401 Unauthorized) is returned
Attempt to access protected route with invalid/expired JWT token
Verify access is denied and error response is returned

title: Service Listing Creation Success
description: Verify that authenticated users can successfully create a new service listing with valid input.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the service listing form page
Fill out the service listing form fields with valid data
Submit the form
Verify the service is persisted in the database via API
Verify a success message is shown and listing appears in user dashboard

title: Service Listing Creation Validation Errors
description: Verify form input validation prevents submission of invalid or incomplete service data.

steps.description: Navigate to service listing creation page authenticated
Submit the form with missing mandatory fields or invalid values
Verify relevant validation errors are shown inline
Verify no new service listing is created in the backend

title: Browse Services with Filters and Search
description: Verify users can browse services and apply category filters and search terms to filter results accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to the Browse services page as authenticated or unauthenticated user
Apply a category filter and verify services displayed belong to that category
Enter a search term and verify service listings match or contain the term
Verify the service list updates correctly on both filter and search modifications

title: Real-time Updates on New Service Listings via Socket.IO
description: Verify the browse page receives and displays new service listings in real-time when other users add listings.

steps.description: Open the Browse services page in a web client
From another client or backend, create a new service listing
Verify that the new listing is received in real-time and displayed without manual refresh

title: Trade Offer Creation Success
description: Verify that a logged-in user can create a trade offer on a service listing successfully and the trade status updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to a service detail or trade page
Initiate a trade offer on a selected service
Verify the trade offer is created in the backend with correct initial status
Verify trade offer notification is sent in real-time to involved parties

title: Trade Offer Status Update: Accept, Decline, Cancel, Complete
description: Verify all trade offer status transitions (accept, decline, cancel, complete) can be performed by authorized users and propagate in real-time.

steps.description: Create a trade offer as a user
Login as counterparty and accept the trade offer
Verify trade status updates to accepted and real-time notifications are sent
Decline the trade from counterparty and verify status updates and notifications
Cancel the trade as the offer creator and verify status updates and notifications
Complete the trade as authorized user and verify final status and dashboard updates

title: Unauthorized Trade Status Changes
description: Verify that only authorized users (offer creator or recipient) can update trade offer statuses and others are prevented.

steps.description: Login as a user not involved in a trade offer
Attempt to accept, decline, cancel, or complete the trade offer
Verify the system denies the action with appropriate error response

title: User Dashboard Data Accuracy and Real-Time Updates
description: Verify that the user dashboard displays correct listings, trade statuses, and statistics, and updates dynamically with real-time events.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the Dashboard page
Verify that the current user's listings, active trades, and statistics are displayed correctly
Trigger trade status changes or new service listings affecting the user
Verify that the dashboard updates in real-time reflecting all changes

title: Real-Time Notification Delivery via Socket.IO
description: Verify that notifications for service updates and trade offer changes are delivered immediately to connected clients.

steps.description: Connect user clients to the application with active Socket.IO connections
Perform actions such as creating a new service, creating or updating trade offers
Verify that all relevant clients receive real-time notification events corresponding to these changes

title: Form Input Validation Robustness with Zod
description: Verify that the service listing and authentication forms reject improper inputs using centralized validation.

steps.description: Attempt to submit forms with invalid data types and boundary values
Verify all invalid inputs are caught by Zod validations and informative errors are displayed to the user

title: UI Consistency of Reusable Components
description: Verify that reusable UI components and layout primitives maintain consistent look and feel across different pages.

steps.description: Navigate through various pages (Dashboard, Browse, TradeCenter, ListService, Login, SignUp)
Validate that common UI elements like navigation header, sidebar, buttons, and notifications maintain visual style and responsive behavior

title: API Error Handling and Graceful Failures
description: Verify that API error responses from the backend are handled gracefully on the frontend with user-friendly messages.

steps.description: Simulate backend errors like 500 Internal Server Error or 404 Not Found on API endpoints for services and trades
Verify the frontend displays appropriate error notifications and UI remains stable

title: Logout and Token Expiry Handling
description: Verify that logging out properly clears the JWT token and expired tokens cause reauthentication.

steps.description: Login and then perform logout action
Verify that JWT token is removed from client storage and protected routes are no longer accessible
Use an expired JWT token to access protected route
Verify user is redirected to login page or receives unauthorized error

title: Concurrent Trade Offer Updates and Conflict Handling
description: Verify that concurrent updates to a trade offer by multiple parties maintain data integrity and notify clients correctly.

steps.description: Simultaneously attempt conflicting trade status updates from different user sessions
Verify backend rejects invalid state transitions, maintains consistency, and notifies clients of final status
